2026_01_DEN_KC.headline: Mahomes’ return collides with Denver’s pressure and revamped passing game
2026_01_DEN_KC.paragraph1: Kansas City expects Patrick Mahomes to return from last season’s major knee injury, giving the Chiefs their offensive centerpiece back for a divisional opener against Denver. The Broncos counter with Bo Nix, a defense coming off a strong season and a receiving corps upgraded by Jaylen Waddle. Kansas City’s rebuilt secondary will be tested vertically, while Denver must account for Mahomes’ quick-game answers and Kenneth Walker III in the backfield. Protection, movement in the pocket and explosive passing efficiency are the matchup’s defining variables.
2026_01_DEN_KC.model_rationale: Kansas City’s offense regains its defining quarterback, while Denver can create leverage through pressure and a deeper receiving group if it forces the Chiefs into uncomfortable long-yardage situations.
